mutations.name: the first draft goes to the plan retry without a re-time
kills: the script stage's plan retry re-times a draft whose only fault is a beat a word or two over its cap, with no plan retry

mutations.name: planFaults drops the draft's template-fill faults
kills: the script stage's plan retry retries once naming a 7-label list resolve's template fill refuses, and keeps the reply that moves rows to the continuation

mutations.name: the single-call repair rounds no longer answer template-fill rows
kills: the script stage's plan retry answers a fill fault the plan retry left in an L0 repair round, naming the refused beat, and keeps the repair
